channel.title: The Argo: the house of 0x647406e3
channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Demlaos #2894 of the House of Udaeus fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow
item.description: Demlaos #2894 of the House of Udaeus fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.title: Astmedes #5360 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus)
item.description: Astmedes #5360 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Timlaos #6631 carved Mellaos #8492 the Twice-Born's name into a rib-bone and gave it away.
item.description: Timlaos #6631 carved Mellaos #8492 the Twice-Born's name into a rib-bone and gave it away. They walk together at dusk now.
